title: Fix MSSQL connection schema field metadata
body:
Fix MSSQL connection form metadata so the standard `schema` field is labeled as `Database`.

This keeps the database value in the standard Connection.schema field instead of treating it as an unsupported custom field, avoiding the `body.url_schema Extra inputs are not permitted` validation error when saving MSSQL connections.

closes: #66752
